title: Add dependency update policy and Dependabot config
description:
Add dependency-update hygiene for npm packages and GitHub Actions.

The repo has runtime/native-sensitive dependencies and fast-moving dev tooling. This bead should introduce a conservative update policy that helps agents and maintainers evaluate dependency PRs without destabilizing active importer work.

## Context
Observed gap:
- .github currently appears to have CI workflows but no dependency-update policy/config.
- Important dependency categories include:
  - native/runtime-sensitive: better-sqlite3
  - document/import tooling: pdfjs-dist, pdfkit
  - model/provider integration: Claude Agent SDK / related SDKs
  - dev tooling: TypeScript, Vitest, Biome
  - GitHub Actions versions

Parallel-safety:
- Infrastructure/config only.
- Avoid package upgrades in this bead unless needed to validate config syntax.
- Do not modify importer parser files.
design:
Suggested files to add/update:
- .github/dependabot.yml
- README.md or docs/dependencies.md, if a short policy doc is useful
- AGENTS.md if agents need specific dependency-update instructions

Implementation guidance:
1. Add Dependabot config for:
   - npm package ecosystem
   - GitHub Actions
2. Use grouping to reduce PR noise:
   - dev tooling group
   - GitHub Actions group
   - runtime/native-sensitive dependencies separate or less automated
3. Document special caution for better-sqlite3:
   - native install/build behavior
   - Node engine compatibility
   - CI must keep the intended no-surprise-native-build assumption visible
4. Do not perform broad dependency upgrades as part of this bead.
acceptance_criteria:
- .github/dependabot.yml exists and covers npm plus GitHub Actions.
- Dependency groups distinguish low-risk dev tooling from runtime/native-sensitive updates.
- Policy notes document special caution for better-sqlite3 and Node-version compatibility.
- CI still passes without broad package-lock churn beyond what is necessary.
- No importer parser files are modified.
close_reason: Added Dependabot npm and GitHub Actions config plus dependency update policy; verification passed with npm run check, npm run typecheck, and npm run test.
